about_the_game:
Tengen Uzui will become a playable character.
Additional contents such as quotes and profile photos will also be included.

[Set Details]
・Playable character: Tengen Uzui
・Profile Photos
・Quotes

  • The main game (sold separately) is required to access this content as well as the latest patch.
  • This product is also available as part of a set. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
  • The content/specs may change without warning.
  • Game illustrations for each character are based on the in-game 3D models created by CyberConnect2 Co., Ltd.
